author: Aubert, B. and others
title: Measurement and interpretation of moments in inclusive semileptonic decays anti-B ---> X(c) l- anti-nu
abstract: We present results for the moments of observed spectra in inclusive semileptonic B-meson decays to charm hadrons. The results are obtained from a sample of 232 x 10^6 Y(4S) -> B Bbar events collected with the BABAR detector at the PEP-II e+ e- collider. Using a global fit to the moments of the hadronic mass and lepton-energy spectra, we extract the heavy quark parameters |V_cb| = (42.05 +/- 0.45 +/- 0.70) x 10^-3 and BR(Bbar -> X_c l- nubar) = (10.64 +/- 0.17 +/- 0.06)%.
